trustProxy.description: Honor X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP / CF-Connecting-IP. Default false. Env: SERVER_TRUST_PROXY=1.

key.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM). DATA_DIR resolves to <repo>/loop-lore-data at runtime.

cert.description: Path to TLS certificate (PEM). DATA_DIR resolves to <repo>/loop-lore-data at runtime.

sqliteFilename.description: SQLite database file path. DATA_DIR resolves to <repo>/loop-lore-data at runtime. Overridden by LOOP_LORE_DB_PATH env var.

uploadDir.description: Directory for uploaded assets. DATA_DIR resolves to <repo>/loop-lore-data at runtime.

maxFileSize.description: Max upload size in bytes (default 10 MB)

signedUrlSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for signed asset URLs. Env-only: ASSETS_SIGNED_URL_SECRET. Falls back to auth.jwtSecret.

jsonlMaxBytes.description: Max JSONL file bytes before rotation

demoAutoSetup.description: Auto-create sample data on first demo run

adminUsername.description: Bootstrap admin username (multi-user mode). Env: AUTH_ADMIN_USERNAME.

adminPassword.description: Bootstrap admin password (multi-user mode). Env-only preferred: AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Never commit.

legacyOpaqueTokenFallback.description: Permit sha256(token) lookup when JWT verify fails. Default false. Env: AUTH_LEGACY_OPAQUE_TOKEN_FALLBACK=1.

useLlmClassifier.description: Augment NSFW keyword detection with an LLM content rating classifier (on by default — the safety filter for extreme content)

observability.description: Observability exposure (liveness/readiness probes + Prometheus metrics). All opt-in.

hooks.description: Content hooks configuration (mood, emotion, NSFW, moderation)

idempotency.description: Global idempotency middleware for re-fired mutating requests

enabled.description: Enable the global idempotency middleware. Env: IDEMPOTENCY_ENABLED=0 to disable.

backend.description: Cache backend: 'memory' (single-instance) or 'table' (shared across instances via request_results). Env: IDEMPOTENCY_BACKEND.

ttlMs.description: TTL for cached idempotent responses in ms. Default 24h. Env: IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS.

bypassHeader.description: Honor X-Idempotency-Bypass: 1 to skip the cache. Env: IDEMPOTENCY_BYPASS_HEADER=0 to disable.

autoStart.description: Auto-spawn external AI servers at startup

llamaCpp.description: Spawn llama.cpp server as child process

nGpuLayers.description: GPU layers: number, auto, or all

mlock.description: Force model to stay in RAM

cacheTypeK.description: KV cache type for K: f32, f16, q8_0, iq4_nl...

cacheRam.description: KV cache RAM budget in MiB

flashAttn.description: Flash attention: on, off, or auto

specDraftNMin.description: Min draft tokens for spec decoding

specDraftNMax.description: Max draft tokens for spec decoding

modelType.description: checkpoint = standalone (-m), diffusion = component (--diffusion-model, needs llm)

llmPath.description: LLM text encoder GGUF. Needed for most diffusion models.

vaeFormat.description: VAE latent format: auto, flux, sd3, flux2

diffusionFA.description: Flash attention in diffusion model only

vaeTiling.description: Process VAE in tiles to reduce memory

eagerLoad.description: Load all params at model-load time

offloadToCPU.description: Place weights in RAM, load to VRAM on demand

autoFit.description: Auto-pick device placements from model size + VRAM budget

type.description: Weight type: f32, f16, q4_0, q8_0, etc.

prediction.description: Prediction type: eps, v, edm_v, sd3_flow, flux_flow

encryptionKey.description: Encryption key for stored API keys

serverEncryptionKey.description: 256-bit hex key. Missing = encryption disabled (dev mode).

required.description: true = refuse to start without SMK (prod guard)

compressThreshold.description: Min bytes before compressing prior to encrypt

keyRotationDays.description: Days before auto-rotating actor keys. 0 = disabled.

anonymous.description: Enable anonymous chat mode. Actor identities hidden from other participants.

headers.description: Response-header policy (browser security / isolation / perf / observability)

reportOnly.description: Emit CSP as Report-Only (observe, not enforce)

crossOriginEmbedderPolicy.description: COEP; self-hosted Alpine/htmx resolved CDN blocker. Still not needed (no wasm/SAB).

immutableHashedAssets.description: Append immutable to Cache-Control for content-hashed assets

linkPreload.description: Link preload hints for HTML documents

hsts.description: Strict-Transport-Security policy (RFC 6797). Emitted only on HTTPS requests.

maxAge.description: max-age in seconds; RFC 6797 recommends >= 31536000 (1 year)

dynamicResponse.description: Dynamic-response optimization (minify / validate / compress runtime HTML/CSS/JS/JSON)

minify.description: Strip whitespace + comments from text bodies

validate.description: Validate html/css/js parse; skip minify + log on failure

compressAlgorithm.description: Preferred algorithm; auto prefers br when advertised

federation.description: Federation/mesh interconnect opt-in. Disabled by default; an instance must explicitly opt in and list seeds before it advertises or connects.

seeds.description: Peer origins to bootstrap discovery from.

seeding.description: Database seeding configuration (default users, characters, etc.)

templates.description: Template configuration — LLM prompts, SD profiles, avatar emotions, image-edit workflows, character seeds

merge.description: Per-domain merge strategy for user overrides

systemPrompts.description: System prompt overrides keyed by canonical name

chatFormats.description: Chat format templates keyed by format id

profiles.description: SD profile overrides keyed by profile id
